title: H2 database console disclosed
description: The response is the H2 console login form: the H2 Console heading together with the JDBC URL field identifies the embedded database console. The form accepts a JDBC URL, so the console itself decides which database to open.
remediation: Disable spring.h2.console.enabled outside development, and never expose the console on a network interface. If it is needed, bind it to loopback and require the database password.
limitation: One response body. The rule reports the console form; it does not submit a JDBC URL and cannot show which databases the server can reach.

observation.body: <html><head><title>H2 Console</title></head><body><form method="post" action="login.do"><input name="url" value="jdbc:h2:mem:test"><label>JDBC URL</label><input name="user"></form></body></html>
